statements.text: A higher-order thought (HOT) is a roughly contemporaneous thought to the effect that one is oneself in a particular mental state. It has an assertoric attitude, since doubting or wondering makes one aware of nothing, and it does not seem to rest on inference or perceptual input.

sources.quote: it is natural to identify a mental state's being conscious with one's having a roughly contemporaneous thought that one is in that mental state
we can stipulate that the contemporaneous thought one has is not mediated
the state's mental attitude is always assertoric; doubting does not make one conscious of anything
